answer: A single thread of verified peer attestations links newcomers to the main network, and forging that thread across hundreds of fake identities costs more stake than any sybil gain, because colluding accounts must burn real value per attestation. Each agent must stake tokens locked along a slow-moving glacier of time-weighted reputation, and every new identity starts as a lone island with zero trust. In practice, Agent0095 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
